description_html:
JOIN OUR TEAM

Als Senior Tax Manager unterstützt du unser Finance-Team bei der Betreuung aller steuerlichen Themen der Westwing Group. Du verantwortest dabei die Erstellung des Konzernsteuer-Reportings nach HGB und IFRS, betreust die Ertragsteuererklärungen der deutschen Konzerngesellschaften und treibst spannende Tax-Operations- sowie Digitalisierungsprojekte aktiv voran. Diese Position ist unbefristet, der Arbeitsort ist München.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Eigenständige Berechnung der laufenden und latenten Steuern für den Konzernabschluss nach HGB und IFRS (IAS 12) einschließlich ETR-Überleitung sowie Erstellung aller relevanten Anhangsangaben (Tax Notes) im Rahmen des Fast-Close-Prozesses
  • Fachliche Erstellung der laufenden Ertragsteuererklärungen der deutschen Konzerngesellschaften
  • Fachliche Kommunikation mit Finanzbehörden sowie aktive Betreuung steuerlicher Betriebsprüfungen

YOU COME WITH

  • Freude an steuerlicher Projektarbeit, Affinität zu digitalen Steuerprozessen und die Bereitschaft, dich tief in neue Ertragsteuerthemen einzuarbeiten

WHY WESTWING

Wenn du ein Umfeld suchst, in dem Ambition auf Kreativität trifft, Ideen schnell Wirkung zeigen und Menschen Raum bekommen, um zu wachsen – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

• Ein inspirierendes, internationales Umfeld, das dich ermutigt, groß zu denken, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, und über dich selbst hinauszuwachsen
• Ein flexible, hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 3 Bürotagen pro Woche – denn starke Verbindungen und schnelle Abstimmung bringen die besten Ideen hervor
• Work-from-anywhere für bis zu 4 Wochen im Jahr – weil neue Perspektiven kreative Impulse setzen
• 30 Urlaubstage, um abzuschalten, aufzutanken und voller Energie zurückzukommen
• Ein wunderschönes, zentrales und hundefreundliches Büro mit inspirierenden Räumen, sonniger Terrasse und gutem Essen – ein Ort, der verbindet und Kraft gibt
• Exklusive Team-Benefits: 40 % Rabatt auf die Westwing Collection, 20 % auf Drittmarken, 10 % Family-&-Friends-Rabatt und Gutscheine zu besonderen Anlässen
• Wellbeing-Support mit Mental-Health-Ressourcen, Sportangeboten und Vorsorgeprogrammen
• Nachhaltige Mobilität mit JobRad und ÖPNV-Vorteilen – für ein bewusstes und umweltfreundliches Unterwegssein
• Unterstützung für Eltern mit unserer eigenen Westwing Wichtel-Kita und einer Partnerschaft mit Elly & Stoffl
• Ein jährlicher Social Impact Day, an dem du dich für ein Herzensprojekt engagieren kannst – weil Menschlichkeit unsere Stärke ist
• Teamrituale, die Erfolge feiern und verbinden – von Sommer- und Winterfesten bis hin zum Oktoberfest


ABOUT US

Westwing, Europas #1 im Beautiful Living E-Commerce, ist in 20+ europäischen Ländern vertreten und hat im Jahr 2025 ein GMV (Bruttowarenvolumen) von EUR 507 Mio. erwirtschaftet. Als Europas Premium One-Stop Destination für Designliebhaber bietet Westwing ein einzigartiges Markenerlebnis mit einem kuratierten Sortiment aus der Westwing Collection und Drittmarken. Die integrierte Plattform vereint Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, B2B Services (Westwing Business) und den Westwing Design Service. Westwings Team arbeitet zusammen an dem gemeinsamen Ziel ""Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life"". Westwing wurde 2011 gegründet, hat seinen Hauptsitz in München und ist seit Oktober 2018 an der Frankfurter Börse gelistet.

Als leistungsorientiertes Team arbeiten wir in einem schnellen, inspirierenden, internationalen und informellen Umfeld zusammen, das dir ermöglicht, deine Karriere voranzutreiben und mit einer Marke und Produkten zu arbeiten, die unsere Kunden lieben. title: Working Student (m/f/d) for Planning & Procurement
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Mynaric
description_html:
Your way into the future

As a Working Student in Purchasing, you'll help keep our SAP master data clean, accurate, and reliable — supporting the planning and procurement decisions that depend on it every day.


What awaits you at Mynaric

  • Clean and maintain SAP master data (material master, source lists, info records, purchasing views).
  • Identify and resolve incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent data entries in coordination with Buyers and Planning.
  • Support standardization of master data fields and naming conventions across categories.
  • Help build and maintain data governance routines to keep master data consistent over time.
  • Build simple reports/dashboards (Excel, SAP queries) to track data quality and flag recurring errors.
  • Reduce manual effort by identifying repetitive data-cleanup tasks and proposing lightweight fixes or automation.
  • Support the rollout of new data standards as they're defined by the Purchasing team.
  • Collaborate with Buyers, Planners, and IT/ERP to trace data issues back to their source.


What you bring with you

  • Currently enrolled in a degree program in industrial engineering, supply chain, business administration, information systems, or similar.
  • First exposure to SAP (or a comparable ERP) through coursework, internships, or working student experience is a plus — willingness to learn SAP in depth is essential.
  • Strong attention to detail and comfort working through large, messy datasets.
  • Solid Excel skills; basic familiarity with Power Automate, Power BI, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Structured, methodical way of working.
  • Curiosity about manufacturing/procurement processes and how clean data drives planning accuracy.
  • Fluency in English; German skills are a plus.


What we offer you

Be part of the company that is changing the world!

Have you always wanted to come to work in your favorite space outfit? Then you are exactly right with us! Forget bureaucracy and work together with inspiring colleagues from all over the world while you embark on an incredible journey with Mynaric to work on unique and challenging projects and make a real contribution to the future of connectivity.

We offer flexible working hours as well as time off in lieu, diverse areas of responsibility, and an attractive compensation package as well as additional benefits such as: a mobility budget (public transport ticket, business bike, fuel voucher), non-cash benefits in the form of a shopping voucher, and company events.

Mynaric is an employer committed to equal opportunity. Therefore, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.

If this sounds like the place where you would like to work, then apply today and become part of a company that is changing the world!

title: Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific (m/f/x)
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Mynaric
description_html:
Your way into the future

Shape the Future of Global Connectivity
At Mynaric, we're building the optical fiber for the skies.
As a pioneer in laser communications, we develop cutting-edge technology that enables ultra-fast, secure, and reliable data transmission between satellites, aircraft, drones, and terrestrial platforms. Our solutions are helping shape the future of aerospace, defense, and global communications networks.
We are looking for an ambitious and commercially driven Senior Sales & Business Development Manager, Asia-Pacific to accelerate our growth across one of the world's most dynamic aerospace and defense markets.
This is more than a sales role.
You will be the driving force behind expanding Mynaric's presence across Asia-Pacific, developing strategic customer relationships, identifying major business opportunities, and transforming qualified prospects into long-term partnerships. You will engage directly with senior executives, government stakeholders, defense organizations, system integrators, and innovative commercial space companies that are shaping the future of connectivity.
Just as importantly, you will remain actively involved after contract award, working closely with our Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to ensure customer expectations, program execution, and business objectives remain aligned throughout the customer journey.
If you are energized by complex sales cycles, strategic customer engagement, international business growth, and working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and mission-critical programs, this role offers a unique opportunity to make a lasting impact.


What awaits you at Mynaric

Drive Growth Across Asia-Pacific
You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and securing new business opportunities across government, defense, aerospace, satellite, and commercial markets throughout the region.
By building a deep understanding of customer priorities, market trends, and competitive landscapes, you will position Mynaric's solutions to solve critical challenges and create long-term value for our customers.

Build Trusted Customer Relationships
You will develop strong relationships with key decision-makers, program leaders, procurement organizations, engineers, and executive stakeholders.
Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand how Mynaric's technology can support their strategic and operational objectives while creating opportunities for sustainable business growth.

Partner with Customers Throughout the Entire Lifecycle
Unlike traditional sales roles, your involvement does not end at contract signature.
You will work closely with the Customer Project Manager and Project Leads to support successful program execution, facilitate customer communications, participate in program reviews, and ensure alignment between contractual commitments, delivery milestones, and customer expectations.
Your ability to maintain trust during execution will be critical in driving customer satisfaction, repeat business, and long-term partnerships.

Lead Complex Sales and Capture Activities
You will own opportunities from initial market engagement through qualification, proposal development, negotiation, contract award, and expansion.
Working alongside Sales Engineering, Engineering, Product Management, Program Management, and Executive Leadership, you will develop winning strategies that differentiate Mynaric and maximize customer value.

Influence the Future of Our Business
As the voice of the customer within Mynaric, you will bring market insights, competitive intelligence, and customer feedback back into the organization to shape product development, strategic decision-making, and future growth initiatives.


What you bring with you

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, strategic account management, or capture management within the aerospace, defense, satellite, communications, or high-technology sectors.
  • Experience developing business within Asia-Pacific markets and navigating complex customer and government environments.
  • Proven success leading multi-stakeholder sales campaigns from opportunity identification through contract award.
  • Strong commercial acumen and track record of delivering measurable business growth.
Leadership & Collaboration
  • Ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels, from engineers and program managers to C-level executives and government decision-makers.
  • Experience working successfully in a matrix organization with cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with project delivery teams while maintaining a strong customer focus.
  • Natural relationship builder who thrives on creating trust, alignment, and long-term partnerships.
Personal Attributes
  • Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and strong commercial instincts.
  • Customer-centric and passionate about solving complex challenges.
  • Confident communicator and presenter with excellent negotiation skills.
  • Self-motivated, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving international environment.
  • Collaborative team player who enjoys working across functions and cultures.
Education & Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Telecommunications, Business, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification is an advantage.
  • Experience with CRM and pipeline management tools.
  • Fluent English is essential; additional Asia-Pacific languages are highly desirable.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 50% of working time.


What we offer you

Be part of the company that is changing the world!
Have you always wanted to come to work in your favorite space outfit? Then you are exactly right with us! Forget bureaucracy and work together with inspiring colleagues from all over the world while you embark on an incredible journey with Mynaric to work on unique and challenging projects and make a real contribution to the future of connectivity.

We offer flexible working hours as well as time off in lieu, diverse areas of responsibility, and an attractive compensation package as well as additional benefits such as: a mobility budget (public transport ticket, business bike, fuel voucher), non-cash benefits in the form of a shopping voucher, and company events.

Mynaric is an employer committed to equal opportunity. Therefore, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation, or age.

If this sounds like the place where you would like to work, then apply today and become part of a company that is changing the world!

description_html:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a gifted and talented Account Excecutive to join our Berlin office.
 
This role involves engaging qualified strategic prospects, demoing the Aircall solution, providing technical assistance, successfully navigating a proof of concept and negotiating contracts. It is a fast-paced role that fits high energy and smart sales people.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Manage prospects in the SMB segment from qualified lead to closing;
  • Use outbound selling strategies to create pipeline and find new business;
  • Position and articulate the Aircall value proposition to your prospects;
  • Educate prospects through complex sales-cycles in order to create excitement and enthusiasm across multiple stakeholders;
  • Work side by side with Sales & Business Development Representatives to identify business opportunities in your pipeline;
  • Forecast your monthly revenue achievements, crush your quota and deliver revenue;
  • Represent Aircall with integrity and professionalism at all times in all written and oral communications.

    • Qualifications:
  • Fluent in German with a full professional proficiency in English.
  • 2 to 5 years of sales experience is mandatory.
  • Knowledge of sales methodologies such as SPICED / MEDDIC a bonus.
  • Successful track record of closing net new business and generating your own pipeline through prospection.
  • A proactive, driven sales approach to identify and communicate business pains and outcomes, drive urgency and take end to end ownership for quota attainment.
  • Demonstrable organizational and time management skills.
  • Competitive and driven to achieve goals, build new skills and bring new ideas on how to do things faster and better.
    • Why join us?

    🚀 Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities
    💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Aircall
    📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit
    🌍 45+ Nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset
    💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

    DE&I Statement: 
    At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. 

    We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We’re working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We’re committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive.  

    We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn.

title: Project Director Schlüsselfertiger Wohnungsbau
salary_basis: Based on leadership compensation records at MKE Munich Investment GmbH
description_html:
Bis heute haben wir Immobilienprojekte im Gesamtvolumen von über einer 1 Milliarde Euro erfolgreich entwickelt und umgesetzt. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Entwicklung und Schaffung von bezahlbarem Wohnraum in Deutschland und Europa.

Wir denken nicht wie klassische Immobilienentwickler – sondern wie Unternehmer: mit industrieller Haltung, Effizienzfokus und klarer Verantwortung für das, was wir bauen. Unsere Projekte entstehen durch tiefes operatives Engagement, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.

„Anders gebaut, um anders zu bauen.“
Unsere Struktur ist bewusst anders gewählt: vertikal integriert, eigentümergeführt, mit direkter Umsetzung durch interne Teams.

Unser Ansatz

In einer Zeit, in der viele technologiebasierte Produkte immer leistungsfähiger, zuverlässiger und gleichzeitig kostengünstiger werden, ist der Wohnungsbau in Deutschland in seinen Grundstrukturen seit Jahrzehnten nahezu unverändert geblieben. Wir setzen uns zum Ziel, dieses Paradigma grundlegend zu verändern: Durch die Entwicklung eines standardisierten, hochgradig optimierten Ansatzes wollen wir die Baukosten drastisch senken und gleichzeitig die Qualität und Verlässlichkeit des Wohnraums deutlich erhöhen. Kombiniert mit der zunehmenden Nachfrage nach bezahlbarem Wohnraum, wird dieses neue Modell den Weg für eine effizientere, nachhaltigere und sozialere Stadtentwicklung ebnen.

Unser Unternehmen basiert auf der Überzeugung, dass Schlichtheit, Kosteneffizienz und Qualität Hand in Hand gehen können.
Durch die Eliminierung traditioneller, kostenintensiver Strukturen – sowohl intern in der Projektabwicklung als auch extern durch gezielte Einzelvergabe statt Generalunternehmermodelle – senken wir Kosten, beschleunigen Entscheidungsprozesse und erhöhen die Transparenz. Indem wir einen Großteil der Planungs- und Steuerungsleistungen intern abbilden, sichern wir nicht nur eine engere Qualitätskontrolle, sondern verkürzen auch die Rückkopplung zwischen Planung und Ausführung. Durch die konsequente Fokussierung auf einfache, bewährte Grundrisse, standardisierte Materialien und optimierte Bauprozesse schaffen wir robuste, hochwertige Produkte – effizient, zuverlässig und zukunftsfähig.

Aufgaben

Als Project Director übernehmen Sie die vollständige Verantwortung für die Realisierung unserer Wohnungsbauprojekte mit durchschnittlich rund 100 Wohneinheiten – vom ersten Konzept bis zur Schlüsselübergabe. Sie leiten das Projektteam, treffen Entscheidungen und stellen sicher, dass Qualität, Budget und Zeitplan nicht nur erreicht, sondern übertroffen werden.

  • Sicherstellen, dass unser Projektentwicklungshandbuch umgesetzt und eingehalten wird. Ihre Vorschläge und Ideen zur Verbesserung unseres etablierten Systems sind willkommen und ausdrücklich erwünscht.
  • Optimierung von Planungs- und Baukonzepten mit klarem Fokus auf Effizienz, Wirtschaftlichkeit und Geschwindigkeit.
  • Koordination und Kontrolle der am Projekt beteiligten Architektur- und Ingenieurteams während der Planungsphase und Sicherstellung, dass unser Projektentwicklungshandbuch eingehalten wird.
  • Führung von Verhandlungen und Ausarbeitung von Verträgen mit Partnern, Auftragnehmern und Dienstleistern, die an dem Projekt beteiligt sind auf Grundlage unseres Projektentwicklungshandbuchs.
  • Überwachung der einzelnen Projektteams bei der Umsetzung der Bauverträge und Kontrolle der ausführenden Unternehmen (Einzelvergabe der Bauleistungen an Nachunternehmer)
  • Koordination mit Behörden, Ingenieuren, Architekten, Nachunternehmer.

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium (Architektur, Bauwesen, Ingenieurwesen) oder vergleichbare Erfahrung.
  • Hohe Leistungsfähigkeit, Durchsetzungsstärke, Unternehmergeist.
  • Außergewöhnliche Problemlösungskompetenz – mit klarem Fokus auf Einfachheit, Schnelligkeit und Umsetzbarkeit.
  • Fähigkeit, schnell zu lernen und Prioritäten richtig zu setzen, um den Anforderungen von Investoren und Unternehmen gerecht zu werden.
  • Unkonventionelles Denken und die Fähigkeit, etablierte Wege zu hinterfragen und mutig neue Methoden in der Wohnraumplanung und im Bauwesen auszuprobieren.
  • Ausgeprägtes unternehmerisches Denken, hohe Motivation und der starke Wunsch, zu lernen, zu wachsen und erfolgreich zu sein
  • Kostenbewusstsein ist für Sie keine Pflicht, sondern ein Wettbewerb – Sie lieben es, Projekte unterhalb des Budgets und vor Ablauf der Frist abzuschließen.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in MS Office, Excel, CAD und PDF.

Benefits

  • Mitarbeit an Projekten, die echten Mehrwert für die Gesellschaft schaffen und das Leben vieler Menschen verbessern – bezahlbarer Wohnraum ist unser Beitrag für die Zukunft.
  • Anerkennung als Game Changer am Immobilienmarkt – mit Kosteneinsparungen von über 30 % und bis zu 50 % kürzeren Bauzeiten im Vergleich zu traditionellen Marktteilnehmern.
  • Arbeiten in einem leistungsorientierten und dynamischen Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Eigentümern und Investoren – schnelle Entscheidungsprozesse und maximale Umsetzungskraft zeichnen unser Unternehmen aus.
  • Ein Unternehmen, in dem Ergebnisse zählen – Ihr Engagement wird geschätzt und belohnt.
  • Offene Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe.
  • Langfristige Anstellung mit der Möglichkeit, Anteilseigner und Partner zu werden.
  • Eine einzigartige Unternehmenskultur, die den Erfolg jedes Teammitglieds fördert, Unterstützung bietet und Ideen ernst nimmt.
  • Gezielte Investition in Ihr Wachstum: Neben persönlichem Mentoring durch einen unserer Investoren und Gründer bieten wir Ihnen Zugang zu hochwertigem Wissen – von Büchern über Konferenzen bis hin zu Fachkursen, sowie die Möglichkeit, an strategischen Meetings und Veranstaltungen teilzunehmen. Dieses Umfeld verschafft Ihnen langfristig entscheidende Vorteile.
  • Firmenwagen Ihrer Wahl.

Vergütung:

Ihre Vergütung (Festgehalt + sehr hohe leistungsabhängige Vergütung) wird individuell festgelegt und kann je nach folgenden Faktoren variieren: Motivation, berufsspezifische Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten, Ausbildung und Erfahrung.

Ihr Leistungsbonus, der während des Projekts in mehreren Tranchen ausgezahlt wird, richtet sich nach Ihrer Leistung und der Erreichung Ihrer Ziele und liegt zwischen 12 und 36 Monatsgehältern pro Projekt.

Die leistungsbezogene Vergütung wird durch einen verbindlichen Vertrag mit sehr klaren Zielen/Prämien garantiert. Der Leistungsbonus wird während der Projektdauer in mehreren Stufen ausgezahlt. Zum Beispiel: Nach Erhalt der Baugenehmigung mit den verbesserten Parametern, nach Abschluss der Rohbauarbeiten innerhalb des Budgets und Zeitplans, nach erfolgreicher Fertigstellung.

title: Kommunikationsstrateg:in (m/w/d)
salary_basis: Based on engineering benchmarks at Hammelsprung GmbH
description_html:
Zur Verstärkung unseres strategischen Teams suchen wir eine erfahrene Kommunikationsstrategin oder einen erfahrenen Kommunikationsstrategen (m/w/d) mit Fokus auf Gesamtstrategie.

Du entwickelst Kommunikations- und Kampagnenstrategien über alle Kanäle hinweg – von der Analyse der Ausgangslage über Positionierung und Kernbotschaften bis zum Maßnahmenplan. Du bist strategische Schnittstelle zwischen Kund:in, internem Team und Umsetzung und sorgst dafür, dass Strategie, Social Media, Kreation und Produktion zu einer konsistenten Gesamtkommunikation ineinandergreifen. Du machst aus Analysen belastbare Empfehlungen und bringst Menschen in Workshops zu konkreten Ergebnissen.

Aufgaben

description_html:
SenPrima baut das erste Seniors' Universe: ein skalierbares Ökosystem für Senior Care, Digital Services und modernes Altern zuhause. Dafür suchen wir dich als Founders' Associate für Business Development & Growth bevorzugt in Berlin. Keine Zuarbeit, sondern echte Verantwortung von Tag eins in einem High-Growth-Healthcare-Startup.

Aufgaben

  • Strategische Projekte: Du übernimmst komplexe Projekte eigenverantwortlich – etwa Markt-Entry in neue Regionen, Aufbau neuer Vertriebs-Kanäle oder Launch neuer Service-Modelle. Du erstellst Data-driven Entscheidungsgrundlagen und setzt Ergebnisse um. 🚀
  • Process Building & Skalierung: Du optimierst interne Prozesse sowie Customer Acquisiton und Experience. Du baust skalierbare Frameworks, Playbooks und Tools auf.
  • Growth & Markt-Strategie: Du analysierst Markttrends und Kund:innen-Feedback. Du führst datengestützte Pricing-, Positioning- und Expansions-Analysen durch und startest schnelle Tests für neue Angebote.
  • Business Development & Partnerschaften: Du identifizierst neue strategische Kooperationen (Pflege-Netzwerke, Krankenkassen, Digital-Health-Partner) und leitest Go-to-Market-Strategien ab.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: 1–2 Jahre relevante Erfahrung aus Top-Beratung (Big4), Venture/Startup-Umfeld oder Growth-Teams sind erforderlich. Relevante Praktika während deines Studiums sind genau so wertvoll.
  • Mindset: Du hast Lust Selbst anzupacken und Prozesse (neu) zu gestalten; bist analytisch stark, arbeitest eigenständig und bist mit hoher Umsetzungsgeschwindigkeit unterwegs. Du verbindest Startup-Mentalität mit Ownership und echtem Drive.
  • Fähigkeiten & Tools: Du bist datenaffin, strategisch UND praxisorientiert zugleich, sicher im Umgang mit modernen Tools (CRM, Analytics, Automation). Komfortabel mit Unsicherheit. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab.
  • Nice-to-have: Kenntnisse aus Healthcare, Pflege oder Medtech; Erfahrung mit B2C-SaaS oder Plattformgeschäftsmodellen; Verständnis von Growth-Marketing (Acquisition, Retention, Expansion) und Unit-Economics. Erfahrung mit Venture Capital oder VC-backed-Startups.

Benefits

  • Echte Verantwortung: Ab Tag eins übernimmst du eigene Projekte end-to-end: von der Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.
  • Echter Purpose: Du arbeitest an einem Unternehmen, das modernes Altern neu denkt und konkret verbessert.
  • Arbeiten an den strategischen Themen: statt enger Teilaufgaben.
  • Direkter Zugang zum Founder Team: und tiefe Einblicke in unternehmerische Entscheidungen.
  • Flexibles, modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Remote-freundlich, flexibel, mit MacBook und den Tools, die gutes Arbeiten wirklich möglich machen.
  • Schneller Aufstieg & Skill Development:: Du formst die nächste Phase: wir skalieren jetzt.

description_html:

We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role:

The Global Tax team is expanding to support Hims & Hers' continued growth across EMEA. We are looking for an experienced, detail-oriented tax professional to serve as the tax lead for our EMEA region. The Tax Manager, EMEA will take ownership of all tax provision, compliance, and tax audit matters for the region, working closely with external advisors and local finance/accounting teams and partnering with the U.S.-based corporate tax team on cross-border tax matters. This role will report to the Senior Manager, International Tax.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage quarterly and annual tax provisions for the EMEA entities under U.S. GAAP and local statutory standards.

  • Ensure the timely and accurate preparation and submission of corporate income tax and indirect tax filings across multiple EMEA jurisdictions, working closely with accounting/finance teams and external tax advisors.

  • Assist with operational tax matters such as withholding taxes and tax registrations.

  • Support and manage tax audits, enquiries and correspondence with local tax authorities.

  • Partner closely with the U.S. tax team, as well as corporate legal and accounting teams, on complex initiatives including entity restructuring, transfer pricing documentation, and permanent establishment (PE) risks analysis.

  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments across the region and assess business impact.

  • Partner with the global tax team to develop and implement tax-efficient structures for new business and existing operations in EMEA.

  • Effectively communicate status/issues to the Senior Manager, International Tax in the U.S. for all EMEA entities.

  • Perform general EMEA tax research to resolve issues and work with external advisers where needed to support business initiatives.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date tax compliance calendars and documentation, ensuring robust control and risk management.

  • Develop tax staff by managing performance, setting goals, providing ongoing training, and maintaining strong employee relationships.

Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or tax required.

  • At least 5 years’ experience in corporate tax gained within a multinational organisation or Big 4/public accounting environment.

  • Professional qualification in Tax, Accounting, or Finance (e.g. ACA, ACCA) preferred.

  • Strong technical knowledge of EMEA direct and indirect tax rules, reporting obligations and tax accounting standards.

  • Experience with US GAAP tax provision preparation and review (ASC 740) preferred.

  • Familiarity with transfer pricing principles and international tax frameworks (e.g., BEPS, Pillar Two).

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with the U.S.-based tax team across time zones.

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, growing environment.

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws.

It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at

To learn more about how we collect, use, retain, and disclose Personal Information, please visit our Global Candidate Privacy Statement.

title: Senior Revenue Enablement Manager, EMEA
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Vanta
description_html:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

As Vanta continues its push into new markets, the EMEA Revenue Org is at the center of that growth — and this role is the dedicated enablement partner making that motion faster, sharper, and more scalable. As a Sr. Revenue Enablement Manager supporting our EMEA organization, you'll operate as a true strategic thought partner to Sales and Post-sales leadership, helping design and build the enablement infrastructure needed to win in complex sales environments. This is a high-autonomy role that shapes how Vanta's revenue teams learn, grow, and perform.

This role will lead the execution of both global enablement initiatives and region-specific programs. You’ll work independently, build credibility with senior stakeholders, and help EMEA leaders reinforce new skills and behaviors with their teams.

What you’ll do as a Senior Revenue Enablement Manager at Vanta:

  • Partner closely with EMEA Revenue Leadership to understand business priorities, team performance, and enablement needs.

  • Build trusted relationships with sales leadership and cross-functional partners across Revenue and the broader business.

  • Diagnose gaps in industry, product, sales methodology, and role-specific skills across EMEA.

  • Design and prioritize a regional enablement roadmap that connects global initiatives to the needs of EMEA teams.

  • Support regional onboarding where needed.

  • Create and deliver enablement programs, content, workshops, and other learning experiences that improve sales execution.

  • Partner with EMEA leaders to reinforce enablement in the field and hold teams accountable for applying new knowledge and skills.

  • Measure program effectiveness, gather feedback, and refine enablement priorities as the business, product, and sales motion evolve.

  • Collaborate with other Revenue Enablement partners to maintain alignment across global programs and regional delivery.

How to be successful in this role:

  • 5+ years of experience in sales enablement, GTM enablement, or an equivalent role.

  • Experience supporting EMEA-specific sales teams and markets.

  • Experience supporting global sales organizations in a variety of roles spanning Early Stage through Upmarket segments.

  • A track record of designing and delivering sales methodology enablement.

  • Experience in SaaS; experience supporting a technical product is preferred.

  • Strong ability to diagnose capability gaps and translate them into focused enablement priorities.

  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills across varied audiences.

title: Senior Risk Manager
salary_basis: Based on senior role compensation records at Trading212
description_html:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We reinvent how trading and investing work by creating exceptional products people love. Fostering a culture of excellence and high velocity is the key to our success.

Over the past few years, our client base has grown 20 times to over 4 million, and client assets have grown over 50 times to over €5 billion.

Role Overview

The Senior Risk Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the business to embed the Risk Management Framework and manage and mitigate risks across the organisation. You will be responsible for liaising with the first line of defence to support them in identifying and understanding their risk profile, assessing the design and effectiveness of controls and procedures, ensuring these align with internal policies. This role requires a deep understanding of financial markets, trading practices, and global best practices for risk management frameworks.

What you’ll do

  • Ensure the organisation’s approach to the management of risk is aligned with its risk appetite and strategy.

  • Facilitate delivery and maintenance of Risk and Control Risk Assessments (RCSAs), ensuring appropriate oversight of risk identification, assessment and treatment are performed in line with risk appetite.

  • Perform periodic independent second line of defence assurance through the delivery of individual controls testing and thematic assurance reviews.

  • Identify gaps in the control environment and work with the first line of defence to determine remediation plans, ensuring progress is tracked and reported on through governance.

  • Deliver Top-Down Risk Assessments through engaging with senior management and subject matter experts to identify material risks the Firm are exposed to.

  • Maintenance of the legal entity Risk Register and overseeing the maintenance of thematic Risk Registers, including the Fraud Risk Register, Market Abuse Risk Register and Business Wide Financial Crime Risk Assessment.

  • Participating in the ICARA process, ensuring all relevant risks are captured, quantified and adequately stressed.

  • Providing oversight of risk events by working with first line colleagues to understand the root cause of events, their impact on the Firm and what corrective and preventive actions are required to remediate.

  • Demonstrating a solid understanding of liquidity risk management.

  • Delivering coherent, transparent and rigorous risk governance reporting.

  • Delivery of Risk projects to develop, evolve and enhance both the design and embeddedness of the Firm’s Risk Management Framework and supporting processes.

  • Provide an overview and challenge of the trading risk to which the firm is exposed.

  • Ensure appropriate horizon scanning processes are implemented to identify and manage emerging risks.

  • Providing second line risk reviews for new product and feature launches, and strategic and regulatory change initiatives, ensuring risk is identified from the offset, with downstream impacts managed and aligned to risk appetite.

  • Support the identification and enhancement of both qualitative and quantitative risk appetite measures, ensuring these are tracked with any breach escalated and remediated in line with risk appetite.

  • Preparing and presenting thematic risk reports and assessments to senior management and governance bodies.

  • Fostering a healthy Risk Culture by promoting the view that risk management is a universal responsibility by encouraging open and transparent discussions without fear of retaliation.

What you need to have

  • Extensive knowledge of risk management principles and practices.

  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking abilities.

  • High attention to detail and risk assessment skills.

  • Effective communication and leadership capabilities.

  • Understanding of the FCA’s MiFIDPRU framework, wind-down planning, and operational resilience

  • Financial management, particularly capital and liquidity management.

  • Management and understanding of market risk in a retail client base.

  • Ability to develop and implement risk mitigation strategies.

  • Proficiency in risk management software and tools.

  • Outsourcing/TPRM experience is good to have.

What we offer

  • Unique challenges that will help you grow and realise your potential really fast

  • Opportunity to make a big impact - you will create products used by millions of investors to build wealth

  • Work with smart, high-performing colleagues with a common goal in a flat, cross-functional team structure

  • An environment where nothing is set in stone, no bureaucracy

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas

  • Generous remuneration package including annual bonuses

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

  • Work closely with the Sales team to improve outbound strategies and qualification processes while also tackling other areas of improvement

  • Closely monitor team performance metrics and KPIs with the goal to increase BDR productivity

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years leading a team of BDRs (Cybersecurity, DevSecOps, Infrastructure, OSS strongly preferred)
  • Experience with funnel management across multiple channels and focuses
  • Hands-on enablement experience in onboarding and learning & development
  • Experience with sales and marketing tools, including CRM platforms, lead generation software, and AI tools
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to make data-driven decisions
  • Proven ability to effectively recruit, hire, and train new people
  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced, unpredictable environment
  • Aptitude for identifying challenges and developing creative solutions to enhance team efficiency and effectiveness
  • Located in the APJ region

title: Manager, Payroll Operations - APAC
description_html:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.

If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

This is an exciting time to join Remote and make a personal difference in the global employment space as a Manager, Payroll Operations, joining our Global Payroll Operations team. As a dynamic and energetic professional, the Manager, Payroll Operations will own the planning, and implementation of our Payroll chapter.

What you bring

  • Extensive experience in regional / global payroll operations specifically in Australia/ New Zealand
  • Understanding of global payroll best practices.
  • Experience in implementing payroll in multiple countries and in managing relationships with third party payroll services.
  • You are passionate about managing people, and you don't micromanage your reports.
  • Proficient in using software tools like SAP, Excel / Google Sheet.
  • An analytical mindset with great problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to adapt to a fast-paced, international work environment with a passion for making an impact.
  • Is a productivity geek and will constantly think of ways to improve and speed up their work.
  • You understand the need and ideal to work largely asynchronously.
  • It's not required to have experience working remotely, but is considered a plus.
  • You write and speak fluent English.

Key Responsibilities

  • The Payroll team will report to you and you will provide them with guidance and mentorship.
    • The Manager, Payroll Operations will own the complete payroll function, ensuring payroll is processed on time, accurately, and in compliance with country specific government regulations.
  • Serve as a point of contact between internal and external stakeholders on all payroll related matters.
  • Lead the Payroll team, unblock and support them.
  • Be up to date with various international payroll laws / regulations.
  • Ensure compliance with all corporate and country-specific regulations, policies and procedures.
  • Manages existing relationships with payroll, accounting and payroll service providers.
  • Develop and implement best practices, key performance indicators and SLA metrics for the team.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Senior Manager, Payroll Operations
  • Team: Payroll Operations
  • Location: APAC
  • Start date: As soon as possible

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Interview with team members
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with Senior Director, Payroll Operations
  5. Bar Raiser Interview
  6. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is

$45,000—$104,650 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at remote.com/r/benefits. As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:

  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • budget towards co-working spaces, learning and wellness (including gym memberships)
  • mental health support services
  • stock options
  • home office budget & IT equipment

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at remote.com/async.

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

  1. Please fill out the form below and upload your CV with a PDF format.
  2. We kindly ask you to submit your application and CV in English, as this is the standardised language we use here at Remote.
  3. If you don’t have an up to date CV but you are still interested in talking to us, please feel free to add a copy of your LinkedIn profile instead.

Not only do we encourage folks from all ethnic groups, genders, sexuality, age, abilities, disability status and any other under-represented group to apply, but we prioritize a sense of belonging. We have 4 ERGs (Women, Disability, Queer, Minorities in Tech) who meet regularly with the People team. During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

At Remote, we embrace AI as a valuable tool while prioritizing human creativity and authenticity. We look forward to meeting candidates who balance innovation with genuine expertise and experience. To learn more about Remote's AI guidelines check see here.

Please note we accept applications on an ongoing basis.

title: Sales Director
description_html:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We’re looking to hire an Enterprise Sales Director to join the Revenue Team. This person will be responsible for building out our enteprise customer base within various regions in Japan. The ideal person will be a proactive and curious member of our growing Sales team, identifying new business with prospects and growth opportunities for clients. A certain level of foresight and knowledge working with intrinsic sales cycles will take this individual confidently into the future of dbt Labs.

What You'll Do

  • 6+ years closing experience in technology sales, with a proven track record of exceeding annual targets

  • Ability to understand complex technical concepts and develop them into a consultative sale

  • Excellent verbal, written, and in-person communication skills to engage stakeholders at all levels of an analytics organization (individual developer up to CTO)

  • The diligence and organizational skills to work long, intricate sales cycles involving multiple client teams

  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous and fast-paced work environment

  • A passion for being an inclusive teammate and involved member of the community

  • Experience with SQL or willingness to learn

What You’ll Need

  • Own the full sales cycle from lead to ongoing utilization for commercial prospects

  • Organize POC implementations of dbt Cloud Enterprise

  • Lead and contribute to team projects that develop our sales process

  • Work with product to build and maintain the dbt Cloud commercial roadmap

  • Become an expert in SQL, dbt, and commercial data operations

  • Be an active member of the dbt open source community

What Will Make You Stand Out

  • Prior experience in analytics, ETL, BI, and/or open-sourced software

  • Knowledge of or prior experience with dbt

Remote Hiring Process

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition Partner

  • Interview with the Hiring Manager

  • Team Interviews; Sales & Solutions Architects

  • Pipeline Generation Activity with Sales Leadership

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time with a culture that actively encourages time off

  • 401k plan with 3% guaranteed company contribution

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage

  • Generous paid parental leave

  • Flexible stipends for:

    • Health & Wellness

    • Home Office Setup

    • Cell Phone & Internet

    • Learning & Development

    • Office Space

Compensation

We offer competitive compensation packages commensurate with experience, including salary, equity, and where applicable, performance-based pay. Our Talent Acquisition Team can answer questions around dbt Lab’s total rewards during your interview process. In select locations (including Boston, Chicago, Denver, Los Angeles, Philadelphia, New York City, San Francisco, Washington, DC, and Seattle), an alternate range may apply, as specified below.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.

title: Field Marketing Specialist - ANZ
description_html:
Chainguard is the trusted source for open source. By delivering hardened, secure, and production-ready builds of all the open source software engineers and AI agents rely on, Chainguard helps organizations build faster, stay compliant, and eliminate risk.

Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and global industry leaders, including Anduril, Canva, Fortinet, Hewlett Packard Enterprise, OpenAI, Snap Inc., and Snowflake.

Chainguard is venture-backed by leading investors, including Amplify, IVP, Kleiner Perkins, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Mantis VC, Redpoint Ventures, Sequoia Capital, and Spark Capital.

The role, in a nutshell:

We are looking for an ANZ Marketing Specialist to support the growth of the ANZ Go-To-Market team. You will play a critical role in supporting the execution of our regional marketing strategy across Australia and New Zealand, working closely with the ANZ Sales team, the APJ Field Marketing Director, and the broader GTM team to help build pipeline, execute integrated campaigns, drive event strategy, and regionalize global content initiatives for ANZ audiences.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys cross-functional collaboration, and is passionate about cybersecurity, DevOps, and developer-first technologies.

What you’ll do

  • Field Campaign Support: Assist in planning, executing, and optimizing ANZ demand generation campaigns across digital, events, and partner marketing.
  • Events & Webinars: Support local event activations, including trade shows, customer meetups, hosted webinars, and virtual experiences. Coordinate logistics, speaker prep, KBYG documentation, and follow-up tracking for ANZ field events.
  • Lead Management: Ensure effective tracking of leads from ANZ field programs, monitor pipeline influence, and partner with BDRs and Sales to support follow-up and reporting.
  • Sales Enablement: Support the ANZ sales team with toolkits, event decks, one-pagers, KBYGs, and campaign updates.
  • Agency Coordination: Partner with ANZ 3rd party digital, and event agencies, vendors to support execution and quality control of deliverables.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of marketing experience in a B2B technology company, preferably in security, cloud-native, or developer tooling spaces.
  • Experience supporting field or regional marketing initiatives in the ANZ market.
  • Strong organisational skills with a keen attention to detail and the ability to juggle multiple projects.
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Digital, Partner Marketing, and Operations teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first, startup environment.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Willingness to travel approximately 20–25% across the region for events and team collaboration

About Us

We live and breathe our company values:

  • We are customer obsessed — We focus on delivering solutions to our customers that create value and make their lives better.
  • We have a bias for intentional action — We prioritize, plan, try things, and fail fast.
  • We don't take ourselves too seriously (but we do serious work) — We are solving an important problem which takes focus, but we also like to enjoy the journey.
  • We trust each other and assume good intentions — We're transparent with decisions to empower team members to make well informed decisions.

A few of the benefits we offer:

  • Flexible & Remote-First Culture: Work remotely with team meetup opportunities, bi-annual destination summits, and a monthly stipend for coworking spaces, phone and internet costs.
  • Our Approach to Equity: Receive stock options upon hire and promotion. Plus, you can participate in secondary offerings and have 10 years to exercise your options (yes, you read that correctly: 10 years!).
  • 100% Covered Health Insurance: We cover 100% of your health, vision and dental insurance premiums for you and your dependents. Nothing comes out of your paycheck.
  • ∞ Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need – to do our best work, we need to recharge and reset.
  • 18 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: We offer 18 weeks for birthing parents and 12 weeks for non-birthing parents, with the option to use it all at once or throughout your child's first year.

If your experience is close but doesn't fulfill all requirements, please apply. We're building the best team in technology and are focused on hiring "Chainguardians" with unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

Chainguard is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Chainguard will process your personal data in accordance with Chainguard's Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Electrical Engineer
description_html:
At Serve Robotics, we’re reimagining how things move in cities. Our personable sidewalk robot is our vision for the future. It’s designed to take deliveries away from congested streets, make deliveries available to more people, and benefit local businesses.

The Serve fleet has been delighting merchants, customers, and pedestrians along the way in Los Angeles, Miami, Dallas, Atlanta and Chicago while doing commercial deliveries. We’re looking for talented individuals who will grow robotic deliveries from surprising novelty to efficient ubiquity.

Who We Are

We are tech industry veterans in software, hardware, and design who are pooling our skills to build the future we want to live in. We are solving real-world problems leveraging robotics, machine learning and computer vision, among other disciplines, with a mindful eye towards the end-to-end user experience. Our team is agile, diverse, and driven. We believe that the best way to solve complicated dynamic problems is collaboratively and respectfully.

As an Electrical Engineer on the Power Train Electrical Engineering team, you will support the manufacturing, validation, and test infrastructure needs of Serve's electrical hardware, in Malaysia.

This role entails:

  • Hands-on engineering support for builds at our CM

  • EMI Scanning activities for new robots, and testing retrofits on our existing fleet

  • Overseeing/Guiding Development of test fixtures with our CM that improves product quality, test readiness, and production robustness.

You will work closely with electrical engineering, systems, manufacturing, quality, suppliers, and test partners to troubleshoot issues, implement corrective actions, and help ensure reliable hardware performance from build through validation.

Responsibilities

  • Provide local, on-the-ground electrical engineering support for manufacturing builds, NPI activities, and sustaining production issues in Malaysia.

  • Troubleshoot electrical failures observed during manufacturing, bring-up, and system integration, and drive root cause analysis to closure.

  • Support yield improvement, failure analysis, rework guidance, and corrective actions related to PCBAs, harnesses, power systems, and electromechanical assemblies.

  • Support EMI scan planning and execution, including test setup review, debug support, issue isolation, mitigation follow-up, and documentation of findings.

  • Work with design and systems teams to identify likely emission sources and implement electrical mitigation actions such as grounding, shielding, filtering, layout, and cable-routing improvements.

  • Provide technical guidance for IAC test fixtures, including fixture requirements, electrical interfaces, instrumentation, safety, and test coverage expectations.

  • Support the development, debug, and improvement of IAC test fixtures used for board-level or system-level verification and manufacturing test.

  • Partner with contract manufacturers, test partners, and local suppliers to resolve production and test issues, improve readiness, and support reliable execution.

  • Assist in creating and maintaining test procedures, troubleshooting guides, engineering documentation, and validation records.

  • Collaborate with remote teams across electrical engineering, systems, firmware, reliability, and manufacturing engineering to communicate issues clearly and drive timely resolution.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 4+ years of experience in electrical engineering, hardware validation, manufacturing support, or test engineering for electromechanical products.

  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting electrical and electromechanical systems in lab, manufacturing, or field environments.

  • Experience supporting contract manufacturers, suppliers, or production lines for electronic products.

  • Familiarity with EMI or EMC pre-scan testing, lab setup, electrical debug, and compliance-oriented validation workflows.

  • Experience working with PCBAs, power distribution, cables, harnesses, and embedded hardware systems.

  • Ability to read and review schematics, wiring diagrams, test setups, and technical drawings.

  • Hands-on experience debugging and testing electrical subsystems using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, digital multimeters, spectrum analyzers, electronic loads, or similar tools.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently drive technical work through ambiguity.

  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

  • Preferred Experience, Qualifications, and Skills

  • Experience in robotics, automation, consumer electronics, automotive, aerospace, medical device, or other complex electromechanical industries.

  • Familiarity with design for manufacturing, design for test, and production test methodologies.

  • Experience supporting EMC mitigation efforts through board-level, cable-level, or system-level design changes.

  • Experience defining or developing electrical test fixtures, manufacturing test stations, or validation setups.

  • Experience developing test automation tools using Python, LabVIEW, Bash, or similar scripting languages.

  • Experience with PLM, ECO, or hardware change management workflows.

  • Additional Information

  • This role is based onsite in Penang, Malaysia.

  • This role may require occasional travel to support suppliers, manufacturing partners, test activities, and engineering validation efforts.

  • The position is expected to operate with a high degree of hands-on execution while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver reliable hardware support and test capability at scale.

title: Partner Sales Manager
description_html:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

We are looking for a Partner Sales Manager (PSM) to join our Partner Sales Team. The Partner Sales Team's mission at Fivetran is to own and accelerate regional partner success with majority focus on our key ISV partners, but not excluding our SI partners, revenue, and growth. PSMs are the “voice” of our sales teams back to the Fivetran Partner Organization to provide input on what is needed from our partners to co-sell effectively in their respective regions and markets.

This is a full-time, remote position based in and around Tokyo

Technologies You’ll Use

  • Salesforce, Zinfi (portal), Looker, Crossbeam, g-suit

What You’ll Do

  • Play a key role in creating the Enterprise regional partner strategy with our Technology, SI, and GSI partners in the region with the aim of driving both partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipelines and wins
  • Create, and action a territory plan that fosters mutual engagement between Fivetran and our partners' sales teams.
  • Planning and executing partner GTM and field activities, driving account alignment, and co-sell opportunities.
  • Create joint marketing and sales opportunities with and through strategic regional partners.

Skills We’re Looking For

  • Develops robust plans for their work, breaking down larger projects into manageable tasks and creating timelines and milestones.
  • Have a clear understanding of the organizational goals and can assess the impact of their work on those goals. Proactively align their tasks and projects to support those objectives.
  • Effectively allocate resources, such as time and effort, to different tasks, considering the available resources and constraints.
  • Able to handle multiple tasks and conflicting priorities, making informed decisions on how to allocate their time and effort to meet commitments.

Ensures Accountability

  • Take ownership of their work, showing a strong sense of responsibility and dedication to delivering results.
  • Communicate clearly and proactively, setting clear expectations with teammates, superiors, and other stakeholders regarding commitments and deadlines.
  • Identify and address any obstacles or challenges that may hinder meeting commitments, taking initiative to find solutions or seeking support when necessary.

Builds Networks

  • Cultivates strong relationships with key stakeholders within the Fivetran and Partner sales organizations.
  • Actively expands professional networks through proactive outreach and initiated partner events
  • Leads initiatives to foster collaboration and knowledge-sharing among partners.

Bonus Skills​

  • Fantastic network in the Fivetran ecosystem of technology partners
  • Ability to acutely focus on the tasks that will make the most impact for the EMEA Fivetran organization.

Perks and Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid medical insurance*
  • Generous paid time-off policy (PTO), plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave policy, holidays (including a year end Global Week of Rest), and volunteer days off
  • RSU stock grants*
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities
  • Monthly cell phone stipend
  • Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.

*May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information

Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.

We’re honored to be valued at over $5.6 billion, but more importantly, we’re proud of our core values of Get Stuck In, Do the Right Thing, and One Team, One Dream. Read about us in Forbes.

Fivetran brings together high-quality talent across the globe to make data access as easy and reliable as electricity for our customers. We value and recognize that our customers benefit from having innovative teams made of people from many backgrounds, experiences, and identities. Fivetran promotes diversity, equity, inclusion & belonging through attracting, recruiting, developing, and retaining a diverse workforce, not only because it is the right thing to do, but because it helps us build a world-class company to better serve our customers, our people and our communities.

To learn more about Fivetran’s culture and what it’s like to be part of the team, click here and enjoy our video.

To learn more about our candidate privacy policy, you can read our statement here.

We are committed to ensuring that all candidates have an equal opportunity to participate in our interview process. If you require accommodations at any stage of the process due to a disability, medical condition, or any other circumstance, please don't hesitate to submit your request by filling out this form. We will work with you to provide reasonable accommodations to facilitate your participation and ensure a fair and accessible interview experience. Your request and any information provided will be kept confidential and will not impact your candidacy. We look forward to hearing from you and accommodating your needs to the best of our ability.
